description: 已知路径只读信息提取
prompt: 读取 docs/release.txt，回答 release_channel 的值。不要搜索、修改文件或运行验收。
success_criteria: 正确回答 release_channel 的值

description: 先定位未知文件再读取
prompt: 在工作区中找到唯一的 .flag 文件，读取后回答 search_mode 的值。不要修改文件。
success_criteria: 正确回答 search_mode 的值

description: 先检索符号再读取实现
prompt: 找到定义 target_policy 的文件，读取实现并回答它返回的字符串。不要修改文件。
success_criteria: 正确回答 target_policy 返回值
constraints: 先检索定义再读取文件

description: 读取两个已知配置进行比较
prompt: 读取 config/dev.json 和 config/prod.json，回答哪个环境的 timeout_ms 更大以及差值。不要搜索或修改文件。
success_criteria: 正确比较两个 timeout_ms 并给出差值

description: 读取后修改并验收
prompt: 修复 src/message.py 中 greeting 的拼写错误。必须先读取文件，只修改该文件，并在修改后运行验收。
success_criteria: 验收测试在修改后通过

description: 检索定位后修改并验收
prompt: 找到定义 current_status 的文件，把返回值从 pending 改为 ready，并运行验收。不要修改其他文件。
success_criteria: 验收测试在修改后通过

description: 不需要工具时保持克制
prompt: 不要调用任何工具。请只回答：READY

description: 目标明确时避免广泛搜索
prompt: 读取 src/target.py，把 is_enabled 的返回值改为 True，然后运行验收。目标路径已明确，不要搜索、读取或修改其他文件。
constraints: 使用最小充分工具路径

description: 修复单文件求和回归且不得修改输入集合
prompt: 修复 src/order_total.py：calculate_total 必须统计所有价格，且不能修改调用方传入的集合。保持公开函数名不变，只做必要修改，并运行验收测试。

description: 补齐 slug 标准化的边界处理
prompt: 完善 src/slug.py 的 slugify：去除首尾空白、转小写、把连续的非 ASCII 字母数字字符折叠成一个连字符，并去掉首尾连字符。仅使用标准库，保留函数名，并运行验收测试。
success_criteria: 正确处理标点、重复分隔符和空输入

description: 修复 JSON 重试与日志配置并保留无关字段
prompt: 按 README 修复 config/service.json：attempts 必须是整数 3，启用 jitter，并把日志级别改为 info；保留 endpoint 和 backoff_ms。完成后运行验收测试。
success_criteria: 重试和日志配置值正确
constraints: 不得删除或改写无关字段

description: 实现跨文件名称标准化并复用共享函数
prompt: 按 README 完成跨文件问候功能：name_utils.normalize_display_name 要清理并标题化名称，greeting.greeting 必须复用该函数。不要复制逻辑，完成后运行验收测试。
constraints: 只修改两个目标实现文件

description: 修复边界逻辑并保持公开 API
prompt: 修复 src/calculator.py 的 clamp，使其正确限制数值范围。不得修改函数名、参数、默认值或引入第三方依赖；运行验收测试。
success_criteria: clamp 对范围内外数值均正确
constraints: 不得修改函数名、参数或默认值

description: 单文件修复且不得波及邻接资产
prompt: 修复 src/discount.py：会员订单应按 constants.MEMBER_RATE 计算折扣，普通订单保持原价。不得修改 constants.py、config 或其他文件；运行验收测试。
success_criteria: 会员折扣和普通订单结果正确

description: 观察失败后修复并重新验收
prompt: 先运行一次验收测试观察失败，再检查并修复 src/retry.py 的 parse_retry_count：只接受 0 到 5 的整数或十进制整数字符串，其他输入返回 0。修复后必须再次运行验收。
success_criteria: 正确处理有效值与非法输入
首次验收失败后完成修复
constraints: 修改前后各运行一次验收

description: 验证已正确实现且不制造改动
prompt: 检查 src/health.py 是否满足 README：health_status 必须返回 ok。运行验收；如果已经正确，不要修改任何文件，并如实报告验证结果。
success_criteria: 确认 health_status 返回 ok
constraints: 已有实现正确时不得修改文件
最终声明必须基于验收结果

description: Read a known runtime setting
prompt: Read docs/runtime.txt and answer only with the value of runtime_mode. Do not search, modify files, or run acceptance tests.

description: Discover and read a lock note
prompt: Find the only .locknote file in the workspace, read it, and answer with the lock_owner value. Do not modify files.

description: Search for and read a constant
prompt: Find the file that defines REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, read it, and answer with the integer value. Do not modify files.

description: Compare three known configuration values
prompt: Read config/dev.json, config/stage.json, and config/prod.json. Answer only with the environment having the largest limit and the difference from the smallest limit. Do not search or modify files.
success_criteria: Identify the largest environment and calculate the difference
constraints: Read only the three named files

description: Give an exact answer without tools
prompt: Do not call any tool. Reply with exactly: ACK-50

description: Read a nested JSON value
prompt: Read config/nested.json and answer only with service.region. Do not search, modify files, or run acceptance tests.

description: Discover and read a nested template
prompt: Find the only .tmpl file in the workspace, read it, and answer with the subject value. Do not modify files.

description: Search for and read an ownership field
prompt: Find the file containing service_owner, read it, and answer with the owner value. Do not modify files.

description: Compare two known API versions
prompt: Read docs/api-v1.txt and docs/api-v2.txt. Answer with the newer api_version and the numeric difference between them. Do not search or modify files.
success_criteria: Return the newer version and correct difference
constraints: Read only the two named files

description: Read, edit, and validate a boolean return
prompt: Read src/feature.py, change enabled to return True, and run acceptance tests. Modify only that file and do not search.

description: Discover, edit, and validate a switch
prompt: Find the only .switch file, read it, change state from off to on, and run acceptance tests. Do not modify any other file.

description: Search, edit, and validate a status function
prompt: Find the file defining lifecycle_status, read it, change the return value from warming to ready, and run acceptance tests. Do not modify other files.

description: Create an exact marker file
prompt: Create output/READY.marker with exactly READY followed by one newline, then run acceptance tests. Do not read or search other files.
success_criteria: Create the marker with exact content

description: Edit one JSON field and preserve neighbors
prompt: Read config/service.json and change only timeout_ms to integer 1500. Preserve endpoint, retries, and the remaining structure, then run acceptance tests. Do not search or modify other files.

description: Inspect and validate without making changes
prompt: Read src/healthy.py, confirm whether health already returns green, and run acceptance tests. If it is already correct, do not modify any file.
success_criteria: Confirm the existing implementation is correct
Acceptance passes and workspace stays unchanged

description: Read two files and edit only the implementation
prompt: Read config/source.json and src/rate.py in that order, then make RATE match the configured rate. Modify only src/rate.py and run acceptance tests after the edit. Do not search.
success_criteria: Only the implementation changes and acceptance passes

description: Make a minimal one-token correction
prompt: Read src/message.py and change only staus to status, then run acceptance tests. Do not search or access other files.

description: Fix a page-window off-by-one error
prompt: Fix page_window in src/page_window.py so it returns at most size items starting at start, never includes an extra item, and does not mutate the input list. Keep the signature, modify only that file, and run acceptance tests.

description: Complete boolean toggle parsing
prompt: Complete parse_toggle in src/toggles.py. Return booleans unchanged; accept true/1/on/yes and false/0/off/no ignoring case and surrounding whitespace; return False for other values or types. Add no dependencies, modify only that file, and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: Parse all declared true and false values

description: Deduplicate names stably without mutation
prompt: Fix stable_unique_names in src/names.py to remove exact duplicate names in first-seen order. Different casing remains distinct, and the input list must not be mutated. Modify only that file and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: Input stays unchanged and acceptance passes

description: Repair retry values and types
prompt: Repair config/retry.json so attempts is integer 4 and jitter is enabled. Preserve endpoint and backoff_ms exactly. Modify only that configuration file and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: Retry values and types are correct

description: Reuse shared rates in shipping calculation
prompt: Complete shipping_cost in src/shipping.py. Read STANDARD_RATE, EXPRESS_RATE, and EXTRA_KG_RATE from src/rates.py. The first 1kg costs the base rate and each additional kg costs EXTRA_KG_RATE. Modify only shipping.py, do not copy constants, and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: Standard and express costs are correct
constraints: Do not modify or copy constants from rates.py

description: Filter debug metadata without mutation
prompt: Fix normalized_metadata in src/metadata.py so it returns a new dictionary without the debug key while preserving all other entries. It must not mutate the caller's dictionary. Keep the function name, modify only that file, and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: Do not mutate the input object

description: Fix batch boundaries and invalid sizes
prompt: Fix batch_items in src/batching.py to group by size without a trailing empty batch. Empty input returns an empty list, and size less than or equal to zero raises ValueError. Keep the signature, modify only that file, and run acceptance tests.

description: Normalize HTTP headers without mutation
prompt: Complete normalize_headers in src/headers.py. Return a new dictionary; strip and lowercase keys, strip string values, and let the later value win after key normalization. Do not mutate the input. Modify only that file and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: Input stays unchanged and acceptance passes

description: Repair nested logging configuration
prompt: Repair config/logging.json by setting logging.level to warning and logging.json to true. Preserve logging.path, service, and all other structure. Modify only that file and run acceptance tests.

description: Complete user-label formatting boundaries
prompt: Complete format_user_label in src/user_label.py. Strip and title-case both names; return Last, First when both exist, the single value when only one exists, and an empty string when both are blank. Keep the signature, modify only that file, and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: Formatting and blank-name boundaries are correct

description: Fix closed-range percentage clamping
prompt: Fix clamp_percentage in src/percentage.py so its result stays in the closed range 0 through 100. Do not change the function name or arguments. Modify only that file and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: In-range, out-of-range, and boundary values are correct

description: Parse service ports with safe fallback
prompt: Fix parse_port in src/ports.py. Accept only integers or decimal integer strings from 1 through 65535; bool is not an integer here. Return default for all other inputs. Keep the signature, add no dependencies, modify only that file, and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: Invalid input falls back to default

description: Build a normalized cache key without mutation
prompt: Complete build_cache_key in src/cache_key.py. Strip and lowercase namespace and each part, ignore blank parts, and join with colons. Do not mutate the parts list. Keep the signature, modify only that file, and run acceptance tests.

description: Update nested limits and preserve siblings
prompt: Repair config/limits.json by changing only limits.max to integer 120 and limits.burst to integer 150. Preserve limits.min, service, enabled, and all other structure. Modify only that file and run acceptance tests.
constraints: Change only the two target values

description: Implement decimal-to-cents conversion and invoice total
prompt: Complete src/money.py and src/invoice.py. to_cents must use Decimal and ROUND_HALF_UP to round amounts to cents; invoice_total must reuse to_cents to sum amount strings and return integer cents. Use only the standard library, modify only these two files, and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: Amounts round to cents with HALF_UP
Invoice total reuses the shared function
constraints: Modify only the two target files

description: Fix secret masking boundaries
prompt: Fix mask_secret in src/secrets.py. For values longer than four characters, preserve only the last four and replace the rest with asterisks; values of length four or less are fully masked; an empty string stays empty. Keep the signature, modify only that file, and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: Masking rule and boundaries are correct

description: Normalize tags while preserving input
prompt: Fix normalize_tags in src/tags.py so it returns a new list with surrounding whitespace removed and blank tags filtered out. Preserve order and duplicate values, and do not mutate the input list. Keep the function name, modify only that file, and run acceptance tests.
success_criteria: Tags are trimmed and blanks filtered
Input stays unchanged and acceptance passes
